LDST 101 - Objectively liberal and will make sure to make strong political statements whenever possible. It's exhausting to constantly hear one side of the spectrum when there is clearly another side.

Most of our grade is presentations, which are harshly graded. We must become experts on readings to receive a decent grade on presentations.
Only take this class if you are interested in Native American History and not leadership.

LDST101- Dr. Wilkins is a kind and caring man who genuinely is passionate about what he teaches. However he does not give out A's, as the highest grade he gives is an A- even to his best students. This class is made up of presentations and cold calling seminar discussions. Not much work to put into his class, but the work you do must be excellent.

Professor Wilkins is an excellent professor under a very specific set of criteria.  If you take leadership 102, be prepared to talk exclusively about indigenous leadership.  If this is your interest, you will not find a more knowledgable professor. With that being said, if you are not interested in indigenous peoples DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!
Amazing professor - very knowledgable and friendly. However, the class is difficult.

Dr. Wilkins is a good professor and an excellent man. Very educated in this subject and expects a lot from his students. You will read a lot in this class and will consistently be expected to participate. A long term paper with vague guidelines will constitute half your grade. Extremely tough grader, DO NOT expect an A. Work hard & learn.

Really, genuinely a good guy. There's a lot of reading, no getting around that, and it's a discussion-heavy class. But he makes it very interesting, and (at least in my class) you could skim and get by. Very willing to help outside of class, and one of the nicest people I've ever met. It was hard, but I'd take another class of his in a hearbeat.

Terrible teacher class. 50% of the grade is based on a term paper for which Wilkins gives vauge, if any, instructions for. The assigned readings are very long and unrelated to the term paper assignment. The class concerns indigenous peoples, and has very little to do with leadership. Giant waste of time and everything sucks about this class.
